# session-title-summary
中文说明 · English
A community plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that renames sessions with categorized, rule-checked t
itles in the `MMDD | 分类 | 主题` format, backfills history sessions, and provides a management panel in
DD | 分类 | 主题` format, backfills history sessions, and provides a management panel in the DSH Web UI.
## English
### What it does
- **Automatic titles**: registers the sole optional `ctx.sessionTitle` provider and generates a titl
e after each human message (or the first message only, configurable). Titles follow the `MMDD | Cate

gory | Topic` format, falling back to `MMDD | Short title` when confidence is low.
- **Categories**:
builtin categories (功能/设计/整改/优化/发布/分析/文档) plus a dynamic ledger — model-invented category words are
kept, counted, and normalized through a synonym table. Sensitive content (credentials, paths) is sc

rubbed and never reaches the model or a title.
- **History backfill**: on activation, scans persiste
d sessions (newest first, bounded batch) and renames every nonconforming title through the same pipe
line — including manually renamed and currently-open sessions. Conforming titles are final and skipp

ed.
- **Web panel**: a sidebar panel with live scan progress, per-session records (old/new title, ac
tual model called, skip reasons), run history, category statistics, and a model-configuration tab th
at pulls the provider/model catalog from the running DSH instance and can pin a fixed title model.
### Install
Requires DSH with plugin management. Either:
1. Clone this repo and, in DSH, install the local directory as a bundle (`plugin_manager install_bun

dle` with the absolute path), or
2. Install from the community plugin index ("Discover" tab) once li

with the absolute path), or
2. Install from the community plugin index ("Discover" tab) once listed.
The bundle patch disables the shipped `optional-session-title-all-prompts` and `session-title-llm` r
ows because `ctx.sessionTitle.register()` is a single slot; those overrides are idempotent and harml
tx.sessionTitle.register()` is a single slot; those overrides are idempotent and harmless elsewhere.
### Configuration
All knobs live in `cordis.patch.yml` under the `session-title-summary` row: cadence (`all-prompts` /
`first-prompt`), builtin & seed custom categories, synonym mappings, local fast-path keywords, conf
idence threshold, topic length, message window, input/output budgets, timeout, and backfill bounds.
An optional fixed title model (provider+model pair) can be pinned from the panel and persists in `~/
.dsh/session-title-summary/settings.json`.
### Tests
`node --test test-monitor.mjs` (13 integration-style tests) and `node test-pure.mjs` (pure pipeline
checks) must pass before any release.
## 中文说明
### 功能
- **自动命名**：注册 `ctx.sessionTitle` 唯一标题提供方，每条人类消息后（或仅首条，可配置）生成 `MMDD | 分类 | 主题` 格式标题；置信度不足时回退 `MMDD |

简短标题`。
- **分类体系**：内置分类 + 动态分类账本（模型发明的新分类词被保留、计数并经同义表归并）；凭据、路径等敏感内容一律脱敏，不会进入模型输入或标题。
- **历史回填**：激活时扫描

持久化会话（从新到旧、有批量上限），所有不合规标题经同一管线重命名——包括手动命名和打开中的会话；已合规标题视为完成并跳过。
- **管理面板**：侧边栏面板实时显示扫描进度、逐会话处理记录（原标题/
新标题/实际调用模型/跳过原因）、历史运行与分类统计；模型配置页从当前 DSH 实例拉取供应商与模型目录，可固定统一标题模型。
### 安装
方式一：克隆本仓库后，在 DSH 中用插件管理器将该目录作为 bundle 安装（`plugin_manager install_bundle` 传绝对路径）；方式二：待社区插件索引（"发现"页）收录
本仓库后，在 DSH 中用插件管理器将该目录作为 bundle 安装（`plugin_manager install_bundle` 传绝对路径）；方式二：待社区插件索引（"发现"页）收录后直接安装。
bundle 会禁用内置 `optional-session-title-all-prompts` 与 `session-title-llm` 两行（`ctx.sessionTitle.registe
r()` 为单槽），覆盖为幂等写法，在别处无害。
### 配置
所有可调项都在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `session-title-summary` 行：分析时机、内置与种子分类、同义归并、本地快速通道关键词、置信度阈值、主题长度、消息窗口、输
入输出预算、超时与回填上限。可在面板固定统一标题模型（provider+model 成对），持久化于 `~/.dsh/session-title-summary/settings.json`。
### 测试
发布前必须通过 `node --test test-monitor.mjs`（13 项）与 `node test-pure.mjs`（纯函数检查）。
